description: Source code for an HTML report generator and server for Playwright test results, including classes for report building, server setup, and utilities for processing test data and attachments.

classes.name: HtmlReporter
classes.description: Implements a test result reporter that generates an HTML report, manages report lifecycle, and serves report files.

classes.name: HtmlBuilder
classes.description: Builds the HTML report, processes test data, creates report files, and manages report assets.

classes.name: Base64Encoder
classes.description: Stream transformer encoding data to base64, used for embedding zip data in HTML.

methods.name: reportFolderFromEnv
methods.description: Resolves report output folder path from environment variables.

methods.name: getHtmlReportOptionProcessEnv
methods.description: Gets HTML report open option from environment variables with validation.

methods.name: showHTMLReport
methods.description: Starts a local server and opens the HTML report in a browser.

methods.name: startHtmlReportServer
methods.description: Creates an HTTP server to serve report files.
